# Extensions reference

Vendor extensions (`x-` keys) that `typed_openapi` reads from a spec. Any other `x-` key is kept and ignored. This page is generated from the extension registry of the tool.

## `x-enum-varnames`

Applies to a schema with `enum`.

Names the enum values, one name per value, in the order of `enum`. Without it a value is named from its text. A list that is not strings as long as the enum is ignored.

```yaml
type: integer
enum: [1, 2]
x-enum-varnames: [low, high]
```

Reported by [TOA351](diagnostics.md#toa351-enum-varnames-invalid), [TOA552](diagnostics.md#toa552-name-unrepresentable), [TOA550](diagnostics.md#toa550-name-reserved), [TOA551](diagnostics.md#toa551-name-collision), [TOA559](diagnostics.md#toa559-name-lossy).

## `x-enum-descriptions`

Applies to a schema with `enum`.

Writes one doc comment per enum value, in the order of `enum`; a `null` entry is no description. A list that is not strings as long as the enum is ignored.

```yaml
type: string
enum: [a, b]
x-enum-descriptions: [The first, null]
```

Reported by [TOA351](diagnostics.md#toa351-enum-varnames-invalid).

## `x-typed-tri-state`

Applies to a property of a schema.

With `tri_state: extension` in the config, the property of a request model distinguishes absent, `null` and a value (a `Patch<T>`). `true` marks it; any other value does not.

```yaml
properties:
  nickname:
    type: [string, 'null']
    x-typed-tri-state: true
```
